label: About
title: About What the Light Leaves Out
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Only Need, by deary and idk, by blue smiley, plus 7 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became What the Light Leaves Out: A charcoal afterimage world, cinematic still: frontal, tightly cropped long-exposure photographic tableau at two apparent depths. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Irregular pale crown surrounding the upper-left dark hollow, Frayed pale crossing at the left silhouette's shoulder, and Charcoal notch in the crown's right boundary.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
